title: The first variation of v(M, θ) as an integral against μ_R
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep U n, and X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ vector field with compact support, spt X ⊆ U. Assume that x ↦ p_x, the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, is μ_R-AEMeasurable. Then x ↦ div_M X(x) := trace(p_x ∘ DX(x)) (tangentialDivergence n M X x) is μ_R-integrable, and δV(X) = ∫_M θ div_M X dHⁿ (R.firstVariation X) equals ∫ div_M X dμ_R.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (X : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → Integrable (fun x => tangentialDivergence n R.carrier X x) R.measure ∧ R.firstVariation X = ∫ x, tangentialDivergence n R.carrier X x ∂R.measure
